name: 1 Click SN Tech Cookie Consent Banner
author: SN Tech Pros

sections.description:
This plugin allows you to add a GDPR compliant banner to your WordPress website quickly and easily.

Features

  • GDPR compliant cookie consent
  • Customizable colors
  • Multiple banner styles
  • Mobile responsive
  • Privacy policy link
  • No external dependencies

Why Choose This Plugin?

  • Lightweight – Doesn’t slow down your site
  • Simple – Set up in minutes
  • Customizable – Match your brand colors
  • GDPR Ready – Compliant with privacy laws
  • 100% Free
sections.installation:
A. From WordPress Plugin Repository
OR
B. Manual Installation
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/sntech-cookie-consent
2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
3. Go to Settings → ‘Cookie Banner’ to configure
sections.faq:
Does this work with caching plugins?

Yes, the plugin works with all major caching plugins.

Will this affect my site speed?

No, the plugin is lightweight and optimized for performance.
